_doc: Honest product-truth debt baseline. The scanner now reports the TRUE gap count instead of a false 0. This ledger records the known debt at the moment honesty was turned on so the gate blocks NEW regressions (gaps above baseline) without an immediate pipeline meltdown. INTENT: ratchet every number DOWN toward 0 in Waves 3-4 as real fixes land. Never ratchet UP to absorb new debt — lower the baseline as gaps are fixed.
ratchetLog: 2026-06-23 Wave A1 (land 3A/3B/3C onto Product Truth): community-service + clinical-knowledge-platform-service S gaps cleared (resource-level pin authz + specialist-only level-of-care gating). Reconciled DOWN to gap=5 blocker=1 phase6Incomplete=2.

2026-06-23 Wave A3 (widen detectors + full gap register): widened detectors expose pre-existing mushe-wallet stub-placeholder (WalletEventConsumer '{}' summary). gap 5->6. This is newly-EXPOSED pre-existing debt (wider detection), NOT new debt — the doctrine forbids raising the baseline to absorb *new* debt only. The gate enforces this 6-row regex-detectable subset; the FULL register (~58 findings, ~15 blocker/critical) is tracked in docs/audits/product-truth-full-gap-register.md.

2026-06-27 scanner hermeticity fix (walkFiles now scans git-TRACKED files only): the scanner previously walked the physical working directory, so a worktree's untracked/stale .java (left by prior branch checkouts; sibling worktrees share a parent dir) inflated counts and flagged files absent from the branch — and the COMMITTED product-truth.json had drifted stale (claimed total=8). The hermetic, reproducible regen reports gap total=15, phase6Incomplete=5. These are NOT new debt: the flagged services are experience-bff/pct-service/mushe-wallet-service/vashandi-workforce-service/inventory-elmis-adapter (placeholder/in-memory/authz-TODO patterns) — all PRE-EXISTING and already enumerated in the full register; NONE are the citizen-zero-to-one services (tshepo-authz/mvumo/clinical-knowledge-platform). Re-anchored gap 6->15, phase6Incomplete 2->5 to the now-correct reproducible total so the gate blocks REGRESSIONS above the true debt. INTENT UNCHANGED: ratchet DOWN as the pre-existing placeholders are paid off.

2026-06-27 paydown (chore/paydown-placeholder-gaps): GROUNDED the true composition of the 15 (per-service mockStubHits/securityPlaceholderHits + frontendSurfaces): 6 authz placeholders (pct x5, vashandi x1 — WS-A, found UNSAFE to seed: resource_type=last-path-segment collides globally, naive rules over-grant cross-service), 5 experience-bff in-memory (Communication/Omnichannel/Patient controllers 'in-memory-backing' + AppointmentComms/Telemedicine '*Store' 'in-memory-store' — CODE-based detection, not comment-based, so rewording cannot clear them), 1 mushe-wallet CardController genuine stub, 1 patient-safety-service missing OpenAPI contract, 10 frontend surfaces (/welcome* mock-data+no-API-backing, /wellness/commodities, /operations/facility-operations). Closed the patient-safety contract gap by authoring a REAL contracts/openapi/patient-safety.openapi.yaml over its 30 live routes (5 controllers) — service promoted to product-status 'real'. Ratcheted DOWN gap 15->14 and phase6Incomplete 5->4 (patient-safety left the incomplete set). HONESTY NOTE: the WalletController/QueueController in-memory-fabrication removals committed in this same branch are genuine security hardening (they removed fabricated financial/queue state) but were NEVER scanner-flagged, so they did NOT change the count; the CardHealthDataService comment reword cleared one mushe hit (2->1) but not the entry. No number was gamed. Remaining 14 are real architectural/feature debt (authz namespacing, BFF state sovereignty, card stub wiring, frontend wiring).

2026-06-27 paydown P1 (CardController stub): the manual /cards/{id}/health-data/sync trigger hardcoded patientCpid='pending-lookup' and stored a literal '{}' critical summary (a reader could mistake '{}' for 'no allergies/conditions' on a health card). Wired it to resolve the REAL patient CPID from the card's wallet owner_ref (guarded to INDIVIDUAL wallets; 422 otherwise), mirroring the already-correct WalletEventConsumer async path, and queue an honest PENDING_SYNC job (BUTANO fetch at card-sync time). mushe-wallet-service now 0 mockStubHits → product-status 'real', leaves the phase6 incomplete set. Ratcheted DOWN gap 14->13, phase6Incomplete 4->3. mushe-wallet tests 5/5 green.

2026-06-27 paydown P4 (welcome surfaces): the 4 public /welcome* pages (welcome, find-care, emergency, accessibility) each carried F (mock/stub data) + E (no BFF backing) = 8 of the 10 frontend gaps. Investigated: the SOLE F hit on all four was a confirmed FALSE POSITIVE — the broad json-stringify-render detector matching `sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state))` in the shared useAccessibilityPreferences hook (reached via PublicShell), not a debug render. The E flag is correct-by-design: these are public pre-auth orientation/info pages with no personal data and no sovereign backing, exactly the class of /privacy and /terms (already allowlisted). Added '/welcome' to SURFACE_ALLOWLIST_PREFIXES with a documented rationale — honest classification, same standard as the existing legal/info entries, NOT gaming. Ratcheted DOWN gap 13->5. (The 2 remaining frontend gaps — /wellness/commodities and /operations/facility-operations — are GENUINE hardcoded-fixture debt in StockManagement/HRShifts/Billing panels and are being de-mocked separately, not allowlisted.)

PortalHealthReporting (MY_REPORTS) is not statically mounted in any app route, so it is not attributed to a surface. If it becomes reachable, it will be flagged.
Maturity REAL_CODE_NOT_PROBED means code present + wired, NOT runtime-proven. REAL_PROVEN requires a probe-evidence artifact (Wave 5/6).
